gates.effect: No seasonal score suppression is required solely for an open/closed harvest season under the 2026 Great Lakes table.
gates.limitations: Bag, possession, size and water-specific rules still apply; refresh for the next regulation cycle.

gates.effect: No seasonal score suppression is required solely for an open/closed harvest season in the covered Great Lakes and connected waters.
gates.limitations: Confirm the exact connected-water boundary and current size/bag rules before public release.

gates.effect: Forecasting may remain live year-round, but the UI must distinguish catch-and-immediate-release periods from the legal possession season.
gates.limitations: Exact dates and any local exceptions must be rendered from current regulation data, not frozen prose.

gates.effect: No general statewide seasonal score closure is required for these additions under the reviewed 2026 rules.
gates.limitations: Water-specific exceptions, size/bag limits and future orders remain controlling.

gates.effect: Within the defined port, allow only one single-pointed unweighted hook no larger than one-half inch from point to shank. Pass 2 must show a method notice and must not calibrate lake-whitefish bite strength from historical snagging harvest.
gates.limitations: This is a tackle rule, not a biological closure; verify the operative fisheries order during each annual refresh.

gates.effect: Keep product geography on lawful public breakwall/shore access. Do not imply that private, leased, closed or operational marina docks are public fishing locations.
gates.limitations: Posted closures and directions from harbor personnel override static app guidance.

wisconsinFinding: This pass recommends no new Wisconsin city/species pairs. Existing live-pair regulation behavior is outside the implementation scope of this pass and must remain unchanged.
